newsitem.title: USA: Pope Resources creates new unit.
newsitem.headline: Pope Resources creates new unit.

text.p: Pope Resources on Monday said its unit holders have approved the establishment of a new subsidiary, Olympic Resource Management LLC to handle the company's investor portfolio management business.
Gary Tucker, Pope Resources chief executive also will serve as chief executive of Olympic Resource.

"Our company has a long and successful record of managing land and timber," Tucker said in a statement. "We will build on those capabilities by locating, acquiring and managing land and timber assets for other investors."
Olympic Resource will work in the Pacific Northwest, but will also diversify geographically.

"Our goals for Olympic Resource Management are ambitious," Tucker said. "We expect significant growth within two years. If we meet our targets, Olympic Resource could be managing in excess of $1 billion in investments within five years."
